description: MobileNetV2-based plant disease detection model trained on PlantVillage dataset. Classifies plant leaf images into 38 disease or healthy categories.

preprocessing.comment: INT8 quantized: pixel values scaled to [-128, 127] via (pixel/127.5 - 1.0) * 127

labels: Corn - Cercospora Leaf Spot / Gray Leaf Spot
Tomato - Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus

evaluation.note: Run evaluation module with labeled test data to obtain accuracy.

disease_recommendations.Apple - Apple Scab: Apply fungicides (captan or myclobutanil) at bud break. Remove infected leaves. Ensure good air circulation.
disease_recommendations.Apple - Black Rot: Prune out dead wood and mummified fruit. Apply copper-based fungicide during dormant season.
disease_recommendations.Apple - Cedar Apple Rust: Remove nearby juniper/cedar trees if possible. Apply fungicides at pink bud stage.
disease_recommendations.Apple - Healthy: Continue regular monitoring. Maintain proper nutrition and irrigation.
disease_recommendations.Blueberry - Healthy: Plant healthy. Maintain proper soil pH (4.5-5.5). Monitor for pests.
disease_recommendations.Cherry - Healthy: Plant is healthy. Maintain proper watering and fertilization schedule.
disease_recommendations.Cherry - Powdery Mildew: Apply sulfur-based fungicide. Improve air circulation. Avoid overhead watering.
disease_recommendations.Corn - Cercospora Leaf Spot / Gray Leaf: Use resistant varieties. Apply strobilurin fungicides. Practice crop rotation.
disease_recommendations.Corn - Common Rust: Plant resistant hybrids. Apply fungicides (propiconazole) if severe. Monitor weather conditions.
disease_recommendations.Corn - Northern Leaf Blight: Rotate crops. Apply fungicides at early disease development. Use resistant varieties.
disease_recommendations.Corn - Healthy: Corn appears healthy. Continue standard crop management practices.
disease_recommendations.Grape - Black Rot: Remove mummified berries. Apply mancozeb or myclobutanil fungicide. Ensure good canopy airflow.
disease_recommendations.Grape - Esca (Black Measles): No curative treatment available. Remove severely affected wood. Protect pruning wounds.
disease_recommendations.Grape - Leaf Blight (Isariopsis Leaf Spo: Apply copper-based fungicides. Improve air circulation in canopy.
disease_recommendations.Grape - Healthy: Grape plant is healthy. Maintain proper pruning and nutrient management.
disease_recommendations.Orange - Huanglongbing (Citrus Greening): No cure exists. Remove infected trees. Control Asian citrus psyllid vector with insecticides.
disease_recommendations.Peach - Bacterial Spot: Apply copper bactericides during early season. Prune to improve air circulation. Use resistant varieties.
disease_recommendations.Peach - Healthy: Peach is healthy. Monitor for signs of bacterial spot and other diseases.
disease_recommendations.Bell Pepper - Bacterial Spot: Apply copper-based bactericides. Remove infected plant material. Use resistant varieties.
disease_recommendations.Bell Pepper - Healthy: Pepper is healthy. Maintain proper irrigation and nutrient levels.
disease_recommendations.Potato - Early Blight: Apply chlorothalonil or mancozeb fungicide. Destroy crop debris. Rotate crops.
disease_recommendations.Potato - Late Blight: Apply metalaxyl-based fungicides preventively. Destroy infected plants. Monitor weather closely.
disease_recommendations.Potato - Healthy: Potato is healthy. Continue monitoring for Phytophthora infestans in humid conditions.
disease_recommendations.Raspberry - Healthy: Raspberry is healthy. Prune out old canes annually for best production.
disease_recommendations.Soybean - Healthy: Soybean is healthy. Monitor for soybean rust and aphids.
disease_recommendations.Squash - Powdery Mildew: Apply potassium bicarbonate or neem oil. Ensure good air circulation. Avoid overhead watering.
disease_recommendations.Strawberry - Leaf Scorch: Apply captan fungicide. Remove infected leaves. Ensure good drainage.
disease_recommendations.Strawberry - Healthy: Strawberry is healthy. Monitor for gray mold in humid conditions.
disease_recommendations.Tomato - Bacterial Spot: Apply copper bactericide. Remove infected leaves. Use drip irrigation to reduce leaf wetness.
disease_recommendations.Tomato - Early Blight: Apply chlorothalonil fungicide. Remove lower leaves. Maintain adequate plant spacing.
disease_recommendations.Tomato - Late Blight: Destroy infected plants immediately. Apply mancozeb preventively. Avoid overhead irrigation.
disease_recommendations.Tomato - Leaf Mold: Improve greenhouse ventilation. Apply copper-based fungicide. Reduce humidity.
disease_recommendations.Tomato - Septoria Leaf Spot: Remove infected leaves. Apply mancozeb or chlorothalonil. Avoid working in wet fields.
disease_recommendations.Tomato - Spider Mites (Two-spotted): Apply miticide (abamectin). Increase humidity. Remove heavily infested leaves.
disease_recommendations.Tomato - Target Spot: Apply fungicide (azoxystrobin). Improve air circulation. Remove infected debris.
disease_recommendations.Tomato - Tomato Yellow Leaf Curl Virus: Control whitefly vectors. Remove infected plants. Use reflective mulch to repel whiteflies.
disease_recommendations.Tomato - Tomato Mosaic Virus: No cure. Remove and destroy infected plants. Sanitize tools. Plant resistant varieties.
disease_recommendations.Tomato - Healthy: Tomato is healthy. Continue monitoring for early blight and late blight.
